title: Tideglass AI art, content and audio production contract
meaning: Production paths and budgets remain binding. Per-asset flags record authored files; runtime acceptance and independent evidence remain required.

production_entry_gates.requirement: Select a representative harbor and producer milestone look with palette, silhouettes, scale, typography, reuse and motion rules; the director and client review a concrete in-client sample.
Client qualifies native engine, source/export adapter, alpha/color/atlas import, phone/tablet viewport and minimum-device budgets on both native targets before bulk art production.

Resolve actual audio-authoring capability or an identified licensed source. No music generation, commission, procurement or distribution rights are assumed. Without a viable source and soundtrack redistribution rights, audio production and supporter soundtrack fulfillment cannot be accepted.

tool_routing.imagegen: Use the installed imagegen skill/tool only after ART-G01/G02 for original illustrated harbor layers, producer parts or decorative cosmetic bitmap art when raster is the selected medium. Inspect generated output, preserve original exports and prompt/reference provenance; generate/edit only the needed production IDs. Generation output alone is not an engine-ready sprite, atlas or accepted style.
tool_routing.native_or_vector: Author UI controls, responsive panels, typography, numbers, icons, calibration routes, flat badges and data diagrams as editable native components/SVG or code. Do not bake text, prices, timer values or entitlement states into raster images.
tool_routing.audio: Available image tools do not establish music/SFX capability. Preferred production path is authored score/SFX if suitable composition/synthesis/export tooling is actually demonstrated; alternative is specifically licensed audio with in-game and standalone soundtrack redistribution rights. Agents can create briefs, integration, metadata, playback tests and credits. Unavailable audio capability remains a blocking delivery gate; do not silently replace final sound with placeholders.
tool_routing.preview_and_validation: Use local rendered previews and device/build captures. Native audio lifecycle, GPU memory, texture import and accessibility claims require actual client evidence; static JSON checks cannot establish them.

category_budgets.reuse: One common environment layer set plus six restoration state compositions; no seven independently painted whole scenes required.
category_budgets.delivery: 7 scene/export descriptors; raster/vector parts counted in shared texture budget.

category_budgets.reuse: Per-family common silhouette and stage layers; text counts and motion are client components.
Reuse harbor/producer geometry and seasonal native overlays; no additional cosmetic reward IDs outside the 36.

category_budgets.media: Data plus shared native renderer; equal accessible path per pattern, no reflex/time gate.

category_budgets.note: Ranges are authoring budgets, not progression rules; support/privacy material is as long as accurate behavior requires.

category_budgets.reuse: Soundtrack packages the same finished ambient masters with metadata, artwork and a documented download route; no extra score is implied. Cue/track counts are production limits subject to ART-G03, not additional fixed v1 inventory.

shared_runtime_budgets.notes: Budget includes active scenes, UI, thumbnails, mipmaps and transition overlap. Package-size target is not a promise; measure actual exports and revise explicitly if device qualification requires it. Background audio and animation suspend according to client lifecycle; there is no render loop for idle earnings.

naming_and_paths.stable_identity: Manifest asset IDs are permanent. Friendly names may change; IDs must not. Lowercase dot IDs map to lowercase descriptive filenames; no spaces, version suffix proliferation or random image-generation names in game imports.
naming_and_paths.source_export_rule: Editable source and original generated/licensed media stay under source/. Deterministic export scripts produce runtime files. Do not edit exports by hand. Per-asset scene/package descriptors list all source media and emitted files with hashes; an engine-specific importer is selected at B02. Export descriptors do not count as rendered asset completion.
naming_and_paths.internal_document_rule: support.operations_runbooks and support.season02_brief are internal release artifacts, not player content. Export them only under release/runbooks/ and release/season-2-brief.md. Retain manifest IDs/provenance/evidence and full release acceptance, but exclude their text and operational details from client packaging; review for factual completeness and operational usability, not player text-scale variants.

provenance_rules: Keep generation prompt, tool/model metadata when returned, references and original output for AI bitmap sources; record unavailable metadata explicitly instead of inventing a seed/model.
For original authored SVG, source text, procedural assets and audio, record authorship and source revision. Do not assume tool availability implies permission to use a reference.

For external media/fonts/music, retain the actual license and attribution requirements and verify modification, in-game redistribution, commercial use and platform export permissions. Soundtrack must separately permit standalone download redistribution.
Credits are compiled from provenance, including font/audio obligations. Unknown, missing or contradictory rights evidence fails the asset release gate.
Never embed private source paths, prompts, reference photos or licensed masters into public build metadata unless intended and authorized.

variant_contract.producer_stages: Five presentations per family correspond exactly to 0/25/50/75/100; gift/unlock state does not create a sixth cosmetic or milestone presentation.
variant_contract.motion: Every animated harbor/producer/cosmetic/season presentation has a static reduced-motion state showing the same unlock and reward information. No flashing or camera shake carries unique information; particles, bounce and parallax can be disabled independently of progression.
variant_contract.text: All player-facing copy uses externalized IDs and the qualified font. Test 100%, 150% and 200% text scale with reflow/scrolling on minimum phone and tablet; pseudolocalized strings must not overlap costs, cover confirm buttons or truncate retained-progress details.
variant_contract.color: Unavailable/selected/complete/error states have shape/text/icon differences rather than relying only on color. Theme and cosmetic colors cannot hide economic state.
variant_contract.cosmetics: Each item has an equipped view, owned/locked preview and thumbnail; previews use the same visual asset and cosmetics do not change hitboxes or core logic.
variant_contract.audio: All information in milestone/Rechart/interaction cues has a visual/text equivalent. Music and SFX have independent persistent volume controls plus mute. Mute/background/resume must not replay stale reward queues.

validation_gates.requirement: Every manifest asset resolves to exactly one contract and exported descriptor; all child media files exist, hashes match, names are stable, provenance is complete and expected variants are declared. Refuse placeholder/unproduced states in release mode.

Import actual native builds with zero missing references; verify color space, alpha premultiplication, crop, pivots and sorting; atlas gutters remain clean under scaled/filtered previews; fonts contain required glyphs. Compare uncompressed reference to compressed output on both native targets.

Exercise every harbor/stage/cosmetic in a deterministic capture harness at reference viewports and text scales, default/reduced motion and UI states. No clipped controls, illegible contrast, visual reward mismatch or state-dependent missing sprite.

Capture worst-case active scene and transition peak texture memory including atlas padding/mips; verify package size and frame time against qualified device targets. Long background/resume and repeated scene changes show no retained asset growth.

Verify all package members decode on both targets, loops are seamless, no clipping/clicks, volume buses and mute persist, concurrent cues respect voice limits, background interruption/headphone change/resume is correct and paused earnings generate no delayed audio burst. Readable visual equivalents remain.

Every equipped/preview/pass/shop cosmetic points to the same registered appearance. Supporter grants only cosmetic.shop.01 through .04 and audio.soundtrack; soundtrack download/restoration works with documented redistribution rights. All exports remain cosmetic-only.

Every narrative text states true objectives and rewards; ending needs no paid pass/all Note sinks; season archival copy does not invent expiration. Accessible calibration copy gives the same reward and cost. Credits, help, recovery and privacy descriptions match real behavior.

audio_delivery.source_master_format: PCM WAV, proposed 48 kHz / 24-bit; final source/import formats confirmed in B02/ART-G03.
audio_delivery.runtime_format: Engine-supported compressed streamed music and suitably imported short cues, qualified on iOS/Android; do not assume a codec solely from its extension.
audio_delivery.mix_target: Document music/SFX loudness and peak measurements; proposed true-peak ceiling -1 dBTP and no audible clipping. Exact loudness balanced in-client; headphones and device speakers both reviewed.
audio_delivery.package_members: Each package descriptor contains member IDs, source WAV/license paths, runtime exports, loop points, gain/bus, duration, hashes and credits. Soundtrack descriptor lists reused ambient masters, metadata and download artifact hash.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Approve one harbor look, one producer milestone transformation, asset reuse rules and a complete asset manifest.
acceptance: One harbor treatment and producer.01.stage.0 to producer.01.stage.1 comparison evaluated inside the qualified client; consistent palette, scale, silhouette and reduction strategy selected.
Approve category budgets and reusable parts; draft styles are not final delivered launch assets.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Deliver modular producer parts, harbor layers, typography, icons and UI states sufficient for the slice.
acceptance: Reusable scene parts, typography, icons and control states support every slice flow.
Source font files and redistribution licenses are present; code-generated icons remain editable; measured text reflow and reduced-motion behavior work in client.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: One area, all five base silhouettes and a milestone sequence establish final visual quality, including reduced-motion variants.
acceptance: All five base silhouettes, one initial harbor and producer.01 stages 0 through 4 are integrated.
Default and reduced-motion presentation preserve state information at reference phone/tablet sizes; visual quality is affordable within budgets.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Five producer families each have base plus four milestone presentations; daily-loop icons and status states are final.
acceptance: All 25 producer stage IDs resolve to distinct intended milestone appearances, built through reusable parts.
Focus/Survey/contract/automation icons and idle, available, locked, queued, complete and error states have text equivalents.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Six harbor restoration states and the fixed 36-item cosmetic manifest are complete; commissioned audio is integrated through client work.
acceptance: Initial harbor plus six restored states and all 36 unique cosmetic IDs are integrated; ownership and previews use the same assets.
Season presentation is complete; five audio package obligations and soundtrack fulfillment are verified; supporter reuses four existing shop cosmetics.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Remove placeholders, integrate final sound direction, and prepare representative screenshots, icon and short footage.
acceptance: No placeholder, missing glyph, asset warning or unresolved provenance remains.
Capture real build screenshots/icon/short footage; device-tested audio, memory, frame-time and readable scaled layouts meet the agreed release budgets.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Address readability, repeated visual issues and content defects without increasing the launch asset count.
acceptance: Observed readability, consistency and content defects have before/after build evidence and regression cases.
Corrections reuse existing IDs and preserve the 36-item count; no unapproved launch inventory expansion.

original_artist_work_items.source_acceptance: Screenshots, footage, credits, help visuals and release assets describe the actual shipped game and offers.
acceptance: Final store footage and screenshots come from the release candidate and reflect actual gameplay, offers and restore flows.
Credits, help visuals, recovery copy and support references match the shipped implementation; release provenance index covers every shipped visual, audio and font.

shared_narrative_obligations.acceptance: All six chapters plus ending, 12 challenge instructions, 12 pattern/accessibility text pairs, 18 main entries and 20 seasonal fragments are authored and integrated; objective/reward data remains director/gameplay-owned, not inferred from narrative copy.
Help/recovery/credits/support/privacy copy is reviewed against actual system behavior; platform authors operational runbooks; art/content edits for clarity without making unverified policy claims.

Director delivers and verifies the initial scoped Season 2 brief in B21/M7-01 before B22 full content acceptance. B22 hands it to operations; B23/OPS-14 updates it with actual launch observations. No produced Season 2 assets expand v1.

production_sequence.action: Qualify the visual treatment and asset reuse budget; resolve the audio capability/rights route. No bulk art generation before approved style and native import probes.
Bind engine import/export conventions and verify representative alpha/color/text/audio assets and device budgets.
Deliver reusable UI/vector/type components and chapter copy drafts against the director progression specification.
Integrate harbor.unlit, all five base producer stages and producer.01 stages 1–4; produce reduced-motion and viewport variants.
Complete the remaining producer stages, daily UI states and challenge-copy drafts.
Finish remaining harbor states, 36 cosmetics, season presentation, all narrative/pattern packages and qualified audio. Populate the registry only with delivered paths and evidence.
Support independent traversal of every reward, appearance, supporter soundtrack and narrative completion.
Optimize and verify actual exports, accessibility, audio and representative store capture assets.
Fix observed content/readability issues with stable IDs and no inventory expansion.

Lock final provenance, credits/help/store materials and exact-candidate presentation evidence. Director delivers the initial Season 2 brief; all support assets and help/support UI are verified before B22 full content release validation.
Update the accepted prelaunch Season 2 brief using actual 14-day launch support findings; preserve the finished v1 asset budget. Initial brief acceptance already occurred before B22.

assets.initial_acceptance: A complete initial Season 2 brief, registered export and evidence exist before B22 full content release validation; no Season 2 game assets are included in v1.

postlaunch_updates.acceptance: Update the already accepted prelaunch brief using actual 14-day support findings; this is not the initial content delivery.

unresolved_production_decisions: Native engine and final adapter formats
Final art style and source parts
Per-item cosmetic visual designs within 36 IDs
Audio-authoring capability or specific license and soundtrack redistribution rights

B14.required: All gameplay content and associated assets, including audio and supporter fulfillment, must be produced and verified.
B14.not_a_release_waiver: Deferred support delivery is mandatory before B22.

B21.required: All eight support content records/assets, including the initial Season 2 brief, plus ui.help_and_support are produced and verified.

B22.required: Full content release acceptance has no support asset exclusions; all manifest assets, rights and evidence are present.
B22.internal_documents: operations_runbooks and season02_brief remain required verified release artifacts but are excluded from the client package.

B23.required: Actual 14-day support evidence and update of the previously accepted Season 2 brief; program --release is final completion after this batch.
